result.summary: 本报告介绍了 Qwen2.5-VL，延续 Qwen 系列的开源理念，在多项基准上达到甚至超越顶级闭源模型 [S1.p4]。技术贡献包括在视觉编码器中实现窗口注意力、引入动态 FPS 采样、将 MRoPE 的时间分量对齐到绝对时间，并将预训练语料从 1.2 万亿 token 扩展到 4.1 万亿 token [S1.p4]。实验在 MMMU、MathVista、MMBench、OCRBench、视频理解及 GUI 定位等多项基准上评估，Qwen2.5-VL-72B 在多个任务上取得领先或可比成绩 [S3.SS1.p1][S3.SS1.p2][S3.SS3.SSS1.p2][S3.SS3.SSS5.p2]。

research_question.text: 论文指出，尽管视觉语言模型取得显著进展，当前仍面临计算复杂度、上下文理解有限、细粒度视觉感知不足以及不同序列长度下性能不一致等发展瓶颈 [S1.p3]。本报告旨在介绍 Qwen2.5-VL，延续 Qwen 系列的开源理念，在多项基准上达到甚至超越顶级闭源模型 [S1.p4]。

evidence.quote: vision-language models currently face developmental bottlenecks, including computational complexity, limited contextual understanding, poor fine-grained visual perception, and inconsistent performance across varied sequence length.
we introduce the latest work Qwen2.5-VL, which continues the open-source philosophy of the Qwen series, achieving and even surpassing top-tier closed-source models on various benchmarks.

method.text: Qwen2.5-VL 的整体架构由视觉编码器和语言模型解码器组成，视觉编码器按原生分辨率处理输入并支持动态 FPS 采样 [S2.F1]。视觉编码器经过重新设计，采用 SwiGLU 激活的 FFN、RMSNorm 归一化和基于窗口的注意力机制 [S2.F1]。为压缩图像特征序列，模型将空间相邻的四组 patch 特征分组拼接后经两层 MLP 投影到与文本嵌入对齐的维度 [S2.SS1.p4]。此外，Qwen2.5-VL 将 MRoPE 的时间分量对齐到绝对时间，使模型能在不同 FPS 采样率的视频间学习一致的时间对齐 [S2.SS1.SSS3.p3]。

evidence.quote: The Qwen2.5-VL framework demonstrates the integration of a vision encoder and a language model decoder to process multimodal inputs, including images and videos.
We have re-engineered the vision transformer (ViT) architecture, incorporating advanced components such as FFN with SwiGLU activation, RMSNorm for normalization, and window-based attention mechanisms
we first group spatially adjacent sets of four patch features. These grouped features are then concatenated and passed through a two-layer multi-layer perceptron (MLP)
aligning the temporal component of MRoPE with absolute time
the model is able to learn consistent temporal alignment across videos with different FPS sampling rates.

experiments.text: 实验将 Qwen2.5-VL 与 Claude-3.5-Sonnet-0620、GPT-4o-0513、InternVL2.5 以及不同规模的 Qwen2-VL 等当前最先进模型进行比较 [S3.SS1.p1]。评估覆盖大学水平问题（MMMU、MMMU-Pro）、数学任务（MathVista、MATH-Vision、MathVerse）、纯文本任务、通用 VQA、文档理解与 OCR、视频理解与定位以及 GUI 定位等基准 [S3.SS1.p1][S3.SS1.p2][S3.SS2.p1][S3.SS3.SSS1.p1][S3.SS3.SSS2.p3][S3.SS3.SSS4.p1][S3.SS3.SSS5.p2]。视频评估使用的基准涵盖从几秒到数小时长度的视频 [S3.SS3.SSS4.p1]。

evidence.quote: comparing it with state-of-the-art models such as Claude-3.5-Sonnet-0620, GPT-4o-0513, InternVL2.5, and different sizes of Qwen2-VL.
In college-level problems, Qwen2.5-VL-72B achieves a score of 70.2 on MMMU.
On MathVista, it achieves a score of 74.8, outperforming the previous open-source state-of-the-art score of 72.3.
we selected several representative benchmarks to assess the model’s capabilities across a variety of domains, including general tasks, mathematics and science tasks, coding tasks, and alignment task.
we conducted extensive experiments across a diverse range of datasets.
For OCR-related understanding benchmarks for scene text, chart, diagram and document, Qwen2.5-VL models achieve impressive performance
utilizing benchmarks that include videos ranging from a few seconds to several hours in length.
The performance of Qwen2.5-VL-72B demonstrates exceptional advancements across GUI grounding benchmarks.

findings.text: 在大学水平问题上，Qwen2.5-VL-72B 在 MMMU 上得分 70.2，在 MMMU-Pro 上得分 51.1，超越此前开源最先进模型并与 GPT-4o 表现相当 [S3.SS1.p1]。在数学任务上，MathVista 得分 74.8，超过此前开源最先进分数 72.3；MATH-Vision 得分 38.1，MathVerse 得分 57.6 [S3.SS1.p2]。在通用 VQA 上，MMBench-EN-V1.1 达到 88.4%，MMStar 达到 70.8%，MME-RealWorld 得分 63.2，MuirBench 得分 70.7 [S3.SS3.SSS1.p2][S3.SS3.SSS1.p3]。较小规模版本也具竞争力，MMStar 上 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 为 63.9%，Qwen2.5-VL-3B 为 55.9% [S3.SS3.SSS1.p4]。在 GUI 定位上，ScreenSpot 达到 87.1%，ScreenSpot Pro 达到 43.6%，远超 Aguvis-72B（23.6%）和 Qwen2-VL-72B（1.6%）[S3.SS3.SSS5.p2]。

evidence.quote: Qwen2.5-VL-72B achieves a score of 70.2 on MMMU.
For MMMU-Pro, Qwen2.5-VL-72B scores 51.1, surpassing the previous open-source state-of-the-art models and achieving performance comparable to GPT-4o.
On MathVista, it achieves a score of 74.8, outperforming the previous open-source state-of-the-art score of 72.3.
For MATH-Vision, Qwen2.5-VL-72B scores 38.1, while MathVerse achieves 57.6
Qwen2.5-VL-72B achieves an accuracy of 88.4% on the MMBench-EN-V1.1 dataset
on the MMStar dataset, Qwen2.5-VL attains a score of 70.8%
on the MME-RealWorld benchmark, Qwen2.5-VL demonstrates state-of-the-art performance with a score of 63.2
in multi-image understanding tasks evaluated on the MuirBench dataset, Qwen2.5-VL achieves a leading score of 70.7
on the MMStar dataset, Qwen2.5-VL-7B achieves 63.9%, while Qwen2.5-VL-3B scores 55.9%.
It achieves 87.1% accuracy on ScreenSpot
setting a new standard on ScreenSpot Pro with 43.6% accuracy - far surpassing both Aguvis-72B (23.6%) and its foundation Qwen2-VL-72B (1.6%).

limitations.text: 作者指出，在将 CoT 推理应用于视觉语言模型时，中间推理步骤可能未能充分整合视觉信息，要么忽略相关视觉线索，要么误解它们 [S2.SS3.SSS3.p4]。尽管采用了基于规则和模型驱动的过滤策略来验证中间推理步骤的准确性，实现最优的模态对齐仍是一个持续存在的挑战，需要进一步改进 [S2.SS3.SSS3.p4]。

evidence.quote: Intermediate reasoning steps may fail to adequately integrate visual information, either by ignoring relevant visual cues or misinterpreting them.
Despite these efforts, achieving optimal modality alignment remains an ongoing challenge that requires further advancements.
